notes.title: New Release - We Walked in Darkness
notes.notes: With the release of We Walked In Darkness you will be able to try and escape the cotton plantation as two escaped slaves. Your goal the underground railroad. One of Cellec’s most recent releases this game is a platform adventure with puzzle elements. It is meant to give a unique look at what it may have been like for two slaves to try and escape slavery via the underground railroad.

notes.title: New Release - We Walked in Darkness
notes.notes: One of Cellec’s latest releases We Walked In Darkness is a new platform adventure with puzzle elements. The game tells a heartfelt story of a brother and sister who are trying to make it to the underground railroad after escaping slavery.
